name: Raxio ET1 Data Centre
notes: Carrier-neutral Tier III facility in Addis Ababa's Ethio ICT Park; Raxio says the site has 2,000 sqm of white space, and DCD reported launch with 800 racks and up to 3MW of IT power.

name: Wingu Africa Data Center - ETH1
notes: Addis Ababa Ethio ICT Park carrier-neutral facility; DCD reported inauguration, 15,000 sqm plot, Tier III design, first Ethiopian IXP hosting, 800 racks and 10MW when fully operational. Uptime lists Tier III design and constructed-facility certifications.

name: Safaricom Ethiopia ICT Park data centre
developer: Safaricom Ethiopia / Industrial Parks Development Corporation
notes: Safaricom announced a developed-land sublease with IPDC to build its third Ethiopian data centre in the ICT Park; described as a modern/telco-cloud data center supporting network rollout and IPDC digital spaces.

name: Safaricom Ethiopia prefabricated data centre
notes: Safaricom deployed a prefabricated data center in Addis Ababa as part of its Ethiopia launch; Addis Fortune reported a $100m facility assembled in China and shipped via Djibouti.

name: RedFox Modular Data Center 1 (RFETH-MDC01)
notes: RedFox launched RFETH-MDC01 at Ethio ICT Park; ENA reported the first modular data center was live and operational, built with a reported cost of $130m.

name: Ethio telecom modern modular data center, Gola Sefer
notes: Huawei-built Tier III-ready modular facility in Gola Sefer, Addis Ababa, with five PODs and total capacity reported up to 800 servers; Ethio telecom later announced leasing space to institutions.

name: Ethio telecom Nefas Silk Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute lists Ethio telecom's Nefas Silk Data Center in Addis Ababa with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; operational state and capacity were not found in public sources during this pass.

name: Ethio telecom Old Airport Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute lists Ethio telecom's Old Airport Data Center in Addis Ababa with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; operational state and capacity were not found in public sources during this pass.

name: Ethio telecom Tikur Anbessa Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute lists Ethio telecom's Tikur Anbessa Data Center in Addis Ababa with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; operational state and capacity were not found in public sources during this pass.

name: Zemen Bank ZBDCF01
notes: Uptime Institute lists ZBDCF01 in Addis Ababa with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; public operational details and capacity were not found during this pass.

name: Ethiopian Government Tier III national data center
notes: Government-planned Tier III national data center at ICT Park near Bole Lemi Industrial Park, intended for government digital workloads and cloud/colocation services; World Bank later referenced planned investment in a green data center and cloud migration.

name: RailTel Ethiopia Ministry of Foreign Affairs data centre
developer: RailTel Corporation of India / Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ethiopia
notes: RailTel is reported to have secured a greenfield data centre project for Ethiopia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Addis Ababa, with completion targeted within one year and three years of O&M support.

name: Phoenix Group Bole Lemi data mining facility
notes: Hydropower-backed compute/mining facility at Bole Lemi Industrial Park in Addis Ababa; African Review reported a 6,250 sqm purpose-built site, developed with Ethiopian Electric Power, with 30MW capacity and future compute/HPC potential.

name: Ethio telecom Debre Birhan Data Center DC01
notes: Uptime Institute lists Ethio telecom's Debre Birhan Data Center DC01 in Debre Birhan with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; capacity and operational state were not found in public sources during this pass.

name: Commercial Bank of Ethiopia CBE-FI Data Center, Phase 1
notes: Tier IV design-certified CBE-FI Data Center Phase 1 in Debre Berhan; CBE tender documents refer to the Debre-Berhan Tier IV Data Center Construction Project Phase I.

name: BIT Mining Ethiopian crypto mining data centers
notes: BIT Mining announced acquisition of 51MW crypto mining data centers in Ethiopia, with 35MW operational/electrified in phase one and remaining centers tied to construction completion. Public primary sources did not specify a region; social reporting places the facilities in Benishangul-Gumuz, so the division assignment is weak.

name: Dire Dawa University modular data center infrastructure
notes: IE Networks case study says the project successfully implemented modern modular data center infrastructure for Dire Dawa University, with an overall project size of 54M ETB.

name: Bitdeer Oromia Region bitcoin mining data center
notes: Bitdeer SEC filing describes an Oromia Region, Ethiopia 50MW Bitcoin mining project: construction completed, 40MW online, remaining 10MW expected to be energized in December 2025.

name: Geek Zone Data Center PLC Holeta mining farm
notes: Bitdeer marketplace page lists Geek Zone Data Center PLC in Holeta/Oromia, powered on in January 2024, with a 70MW mining-farm load and direct grid power agreement; third-party map also lists a Bitdeer Oromia site near Bobe/Holeta.
